content.short: PayRam is a self-hosted, private payment gateway for accepting stablecoin and card payments.
content.description: PayRam lets merchants and AI agents accept crypto and card payments on self-hosted infrastructure they own, with no signup, approvals or account freezes. It reports more than $100 million settled for over 100 merchants. Stable's official ecosystem page lists PayRam.
content.meta: PayRam is a self-hosted private payment gateway for stablecoins and cards, listed on Stable.
